# Release Notes - v1.17.4

## Fixes

### Tallyhall - Receipts with a zero-tax line are no longer flagged as incomplete

- If a receipt listed a tax line of 0.00 (common for exempt items, tips, and some international merchants), the scanner read it as a missing tax amount and marked the expense **Incomplete**, so it could not be submitted until the employee typed the tax in by hand.
- A zero tax line is now accepted as a real value: the expense is submittable straight away, the yellow "needs attention" badge no longer appears, and the expense detail shows a short note that the receipt reported zero tax rather than leaving the field blank.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tallyhall/app/compare/v1.17.3...v1.17.4
